MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick would add streaming to the television I already have, making it a useful next step alongside my DVD player.",
    "Connecting a new way to watch media to my existing equipment fits my habit of buying accessories that give my devices a practical use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The security cameras and video doorbell do not follow from my photography purchases: tripods, film, and lens caps support taking pictures, while home monitoring serves a different need.",
    "The 4K streaming sticks offer display features my listed 720p television cannot use, so I would choose the HD option.",
    "Smart plugs and Echo devices assume I want voice control or home automation, but my power strips, cables, and car mounts address straightforward connection, charging, and mounting needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broad range of Alexa devices, although I have not shown a need for voice assistance.",
    "My interest in cameras and electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in security equipment and smart home gadgets, despite their different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, adapters, readers, cables, and holders suggest that compatibility with equipment I already use matters when I choose something new.",
    "The specific capabilities of my existing devices matter: HD streaming suits my television, while 4K features do not solve a current need.",
    "My recent lens cap purchase continues a pattern of maintaining photography equipment, which feels more relevant to me than starting a home monitoring setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics and media but missed my stronger focus on practical additions to equipment I already use."
}
